definitions.gloss: end of a war; war's end
definitions.explanation: The conclusion of a war. In Japanese, most commonly refers to the end of World War II on August 15, 1945, when Japan accepted the Potsdam Declaration.

examples.japanese: {終戦|しゅうせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧80⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Eighty years have passed since the end of the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{終戦|しゅうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather often told me about the day the war ended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧8⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧15⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終戦記念日|しゅうせんきねんび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Every year on August 15th, a ceremony is held to mark the anniversary of the end of the war.

notes: When used without further context in Japan, {終戦|しゅうせん} almost always refers to the end of World War II (August 15, 1945). {終戦記念日|しゅうせんきねんび} (August 15) is a national day of remembrance, though not an official public holiday. Compare with ⟦{敗戦|はいせん}→敗戦：12917_haisen⟧ (defeat in war), which more explicitly frames the event as a loss. The choice between {終戦|しゅうせん} and ⟦{敗戦|はいせん}→敗戦：12917_haisen⟧ can carry political nuance.
